correctness.rationale: The unnormalized unit-cycle Green matrix equals (n^2-1)/(12n)-d(n-d)/(2n). On zero-mean space a rank-one conductance change gives G+delta vv^T, with v_j=(n-1-2j)/(2n) and delta=n(1-w)/(1+(n-1)w). The dual of the infinity unit ball intersected with sum-zero is exactly the sum of absolute deviations of each Green row from its median. Finite summation gives P_n(1)=n^2/32 with precise mod-4 corrections. A bounded rank-one perturbation changes signs only O_w(1) indices near the two median crossings; the uniform row expansion yields n*delta*K(i/n)+O_w(1), where K(x)=(1/2-x)H(x), H=x on [0,1/4], 1/2-x on [1/4,3/4], x-1 on [3/4,1]. Its maximum is 1/16 at 1/4 and 3/4, zero at 0,1/2,1. The argument is for fixed w; no w_n->0 uniformity. Fresh independent matrix inversions and row-median norms checked n=3,4,9,20,64 and conductances 2/5,1,3 against the rank-one and homogeneous identities.
